handbookNote: Batch-2 depth expansion of Ohio Revised Code Chapter 147 (Notaries Public), as substantially rewritten by the 2019 notary modernization act (Senate Bill 263, 132nd General Assembly, effective September 20, 2019) and subsequently amended through House Bill 315 (135th General Assembly, effective April 3, 2025) -- this batch mines previously-untapped subsections and definitions from the same statute (R.C. 147.011, 147.021-.022, 147.031-.032, 147.04-.041, 147.05-.06, 147.32, 147.37-.371, 147.39-.40, 147.49-.58, 147.591, 147.60-.66, 147.141-.142) to add scenario/application questions, procedural detail, and statutory edge cases not covered in the original 86-question batch 1, plus one new grounded topic (adult-abuse mandatory reporting under R.C. 5101.63, which lists R.C. 147.01 notaries among mandated reporters) confirmed current via codes.ohio.gov; price matches the established batch-1 Notary tier ($9.99), not a placeholder
